description: The project that ng new creates, with a development server started by ng serve and a test runner started by ng test.
The file whose rules, such as /api/** to http://localhost:8080, make the dev server forward API calls so the browser sees one origin.
The single service that knows the URLs and types of the back end and reads its base path from an injection token.
Spring's page numbering, where the first page is page 0 and the screen label adds one.
The order in which a template checks a resource, because reading its value in the error state throws.
Messages from a Problem Details errors list that are attached to the form field they name, with other problems shown at form level.
